description: C.7 -- replay save-to-file + list/open/select of saved sessions + export. Make replay able to OPEN a saved .ffscrm session for replay (not only the active in-memory collection): CAPTURE REPLAY <file> / CAPTURE LOAD <file> load the archive (reuse ff_scrm::load_archive via handle_capture_load) then open the ScrmViewer; bare CAPTURE REPLAY opens a saved-session PICKER modal that lists the *.ffscrm files in scrm_dir() (the same ffwb-domain captures dir as FEAT-002) and, on selection, dispatches CAPTURE REPLAY <path> through the single front door. The ScrmViewer stays a WorkspaceContext (InteriorFocus + its existing first-interior id; the mandatory first-Tab egui_kittest is already satisfied and not re-added). Confirm a saved session EXPORTS to PDF now via the existing CAPTURE EXPORT PDF path (ff_scrm::export_pdf, selectable text); ODT/ODP deferred (NOT-COVERED). Depends on FEAT-002 for the shared ScrmUiState sub-struct and the update_dialogs render pattern.
steps: In crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_scrm.rs::handle_capture REPLAY arm: when the arg is non-empty, load the archive first (reuse handle_capture_load -> ff_scrm::load_archive into self.scrm.load(...)) then call open_scrm_viewer(); when the arg is empty, open the picker modal (set scrm_ui.replay_picker). Keep CAPTURE LOAD <file> working and share the one load path.
Add `replay_picker: Option<ReplayPickerState>` to the ScrmUiState grouped sub-struct in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/state_groups.rs (added in FEAT-002).

Create crates/ff-desktop/src/scrm_session_picker.rs: ReplayPickerState + a render(ctx, &mut ReplayPickerState, &[entries]) -> Outcome modal listing the *.ffscrm files found in scrm_dir() (show file stems; empty-state label when none); Cancel/Escape closes.

In crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/update_dialogs.rs::render_overlays add a guarded block (if scrm_ui.replay_picker.is_some()) that enumerates scrm_dir() for *.ffscrm, renders the picker, and on selection dispatches `CAPTURE REPLAY <absolute-path>` via self.handle_command then closes.
Register `mod scrm_session_picker;` alongside the other top-level module declarations.

Confirm saved-session PDF export: ensure the Save-As/picker offer PDF and that CAPTURE EXPORT PDF on a loaded collection writes a non-empty selectable-text PDF via the existing handle_capture_export path (no new code expected; add a test).
acceptance_criteria: CAPTURE REPLAY <file> loads the saved .ffscrm then opens the ScrmViewer on the loaded collection (Req 10.11).
Bare CAPTURE REPLAY opens a picker listing the *.ffscrm files in scrm_dir(); selecting one dispatches CAPTURE REPLAY <path> through the front door (Req 10.12).
CAPTURE LOAD <file> continues to work; all paths go through the single dispatch seam (Req 11).
A saved session exports to PDF via CAPTURE EXPORT PDF with screen content as selectable text; ODT/ODP remain deferred (Req 10.13).
The ScrmViewer remains a WorkspaceContext reporting InteriorFocus (unchanged); the picker is a modal overlay, not a Context.
findings: IMPLEMENTED. CAPTURE REPLAY now has a dedicated handler `handle_capture_replay(arg)` in shell/commands_scrm.rs: non-empty arg LOADs via the existing `handle_capture_load` (ff_scrm::load_archive) and, only on a 'Loaded collection' success message, calls `open_scrm_viewer()`; a failed load surfaces the error and does NOT open the viewer (avoids showing a stale active collection). Empty arg sets `scrm_ui.replay_picker = Some(ReplayPickerState::new())`. CAPTURE LOAD/OPEN is unchanged and shares the one load path. BEHAVIOUR CHANGE (per Req 10.12, deliberate): bare CAPTURE REPLAY NO LONGER opens the in-memory viewer -- it opens the picker, ALWAYS (even with an active collection or with none), because the picker lists SAVED files on disk. Two pre-existing tests that encoded the old bare-REPLAY behaviour were updated accordingly: `capture_replay_without_collection_reports_nothing` and `capture_replay_opens_viewer_when_collection_exists` were replaced by `capture_replay_bare_without_collection_opens_picker` / `capture_replay_bare_with_collection_opens_picker`; and the mandatory WorkspaceContext first-Tab test `full_shell_scrm_viewer_first_tab_focuses_first_control` (shell/tests_focus.rs) now opens the viewer via the FILE form (CAPTURE SAVE then CAPTURE REPLAY <abs-path>) using a TempDir scrm dir override. NEW module scrm_session_picker.rs (SessionEntry{path,stem}, ReplayPickerState, Outcome{Open,Selected(PathBuf),Cancel}, render(ctx,&mut state,&[SessionEntry]) as an egui::Modal; empty-state label; Cancel/Escape/dimmed-background cancels). Registered `mod scrm_session_picker;` in main.rs. Overlay dispatch: shell/update_dialogs_scrm.rs gained `render_scrm_replay_picker_overlay` (enumerates scrm_dir() for *.ffscrm fresh each frame via `enumerate_saved_scrm_sessions`, sorted by stem, non-ffscrm ignored; on Selected dispatches `CAPTURE REPLAY <absolute-path>` through self.handle_command -- the single front door; sets modal_open guard) and update_dialogs.rs calls it right after the Save-As overlay. ScrmViewer is unchanged and remains a WorkspaceContext; the picker is a modal overlay, not a Context (no InteriorFocus/first-Tab test for it, per context.json). PDF export of a saved session CONFIRMED: no new code -- `saved_session_exports_to_pdf_with_selectable_text` saves+purges+LOADs then CAPTURE EXPORT PDF and asserts %PDF header + a ' Tj' selectable-text operator. SAVE-AS modal (FEAT-002) already offers PDF via OutputType::Pdf. ODT/ODP remain NOT-COVERED (deferred). 400-line rule: adding handle_capture_replay pushed commands_scrm.rs to 423 lines, so `handle_pfshow` (unrelated, self-contained) was moved verbatim to the new shell/commands_pfshow.rs (`mod commands_pfshow;` added to shell/mod.rs) -- pure code movement, no behaviour change; commands_scrm.rs is now 365 lines. For later features: the picker carries NO list state itself (the shell enumerates scrm_dir() each frame), so a future enhancement (e.g. show capture counts, delete-from-picker) adds to enumerate_saved_scrm_sessions / SessionEntry without touching the dispatch. `SessionEntry` and `enumerate_saved_scrm_sessions` are reusable for any future saved-session listing (e.g. a SESSIONS verb). VERIFICATION (scoped, worktree, logs read back): cargo check -p ff-desktop OK; cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings clean; cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check clean; cargo test -p ff-desktop scrm = 59 passed, 0 failed; cargo test -p ff-scrm = 32 unit + 2 property passed. Full-workspace gate left to the owner.
